title.en: The income statement: five levels of profit

summary.zh-TW: 從一家文具社、一家補習班和一家麵包坊的帳，一層一層看懂損益表：先是營業毛利，往下走到營業利益與經常利益，再到稅前淨利，最後是本期淨利；也學會營業成本怎麼算，以及哪些收益不算本業。
summary.en: Through the books of a stationery shop, a tutoring centre and a bakery, read the income statement one level at a time: gross profit first, then down through operating profit and ordinary profit to profit before tax, and finally profit for the period; learn too how cost of sales is worked out and which gains do not belong to the core business.
